names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 14 Μαρτίου, «Άγιος Αλέξανδρος, ο εν Πύδνη», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 13 марта ст. ст., «Александр Пиднский, пресвитер, сщмч.», with the rank words left off. The day's own line declines the name to «Александра» and gives no epithet.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 13 марта ст. ст. — «Мч. Александра (305-311).»

attestations.note: The day's line ranks him «Мч.», a martyr, while the name link behind it ranks him «Александр Пиднский, пресвитер, сщмч.», a presbyter and hieromartyr, and the reading behind the line opens «Святой мученик Александр был пресвитером в городе Пидне, недалеко от Солуни». The presbyter's grade is taken into types on the strength of that sentence; the hieromartyr rank the name link gives is recorded here and not written, because the day's own line does not give it. The Russian julian 13/3 is the day before the Greek revised-julian 14/3 this folder already carried, which is a difference of one day in two calendars and not a second feast.
Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for the same civil day (30 September 2026).

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 14ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιος Αλέξανδρος, ο εν Πύδνη»

attestations.note: The page has him first in the darkness of error and then shining by a good confession, rebuking the error of the idolaters and beheaded when flatteries failed; it says God rewarded him with the gift of healing and records a relic, «Η Κάρα του Αγίου βρίσκεται στην Ιερά Μονή Μεγ. Λαύρας Αγίου Όρους». It gives no year, no emperor and no hymn. The corpus's Alexander of Side, whom the Romanian calendar keeps on this same day, is a presbyter of Side in Pamphylia under Aurelian in a different account; this entry is the Alexander the Greek calendar places at Pydna, and the two are kept apart.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding menologion day (30 September 2026).

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru closes the line for 13 марта ст. ст. with «(305-311)», and the reading behind it names the reign: «Во время гонений на христиан при императоре Максимиане Галерии(305 - 311) святой Александр был подвергнут жестоким истязаниям, а затем обезглавлен». The reign is the interval the page prints; it gives no year of death.
